Q: Redis Insight cannot connect to a database through SSH tunnel, while redis-cli works fine A:

Redis Insight has a ssh tunneling feature:

Steps:

  1. Add a database

  2. Enter your elasticache host name and port

  3. Go to security and enable use tls if it requires that.

  4. And also use ssh tunnel feature:

  5. Add ur bastion host ip in host and port be 22

  6. enter the username for ur bastion host and .pem file private key

this make your redis connection

Q: Associatively sorting a table by value in Lua A:

Sometimes it is enough to have an iterator enumerating the elements in the prescribed order. The values of table t2 are key-value pairs from the original table t to avoid getting the value by key when sorting. The key comparison (and a[1] < b[1]) has also been added in case the values are equal.

Iterator on closure:

function ordered_pairs(t)
    local t2 = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do table.insert(t2, {k, v}) end
    table.sort(t2, function(a, b)
        return a[2] == b[2] and a[1] < b[1] or a[2] < b[2]
    end)
    local i = 1
    return function()
        v = t2[i]
        if not v then return nil end
        i = i + 1
        return v[1], v[2]
    end
end

Iterator on coroutine:

function ordered_pairs(t)
    return coroutine.wrap(
        function()
            local t2 = {}
            for k, v in pairs(t) do table.insert(t2, {k, v}) end
            table.sort(t2, function(a, b)
                return a[2] == b[2] and a[1] < b[1] or a[2] < b[2]
            end)
            for k, v in pairs(t2) do coroutine.yield(v[1], v[2]) end
        end)
end

Q: C++ use of std::move for return of rvalue function parameter? A:

Using move on return values is (almost) never needed and prevents optimization

Q: Ansible: read remote file A:

Either run with the --diff flag (outputs a diff when the destination file changes) ..

ansible-playbook --diff server.yaml

or slurp it up ..

- name: Slurp hosts file
  slurp:
    src: /etc/hosts
  register: slurpfile

- debug: msg="{{ slurpfile['content'] | b64decode }}"
